browsers.label: Microsoft Edge
browsers.exception: The authoritative Linux CI image does not provide Edge; Chromium-engine automated coverage is shared with Chrome, but Edge branding/integration behavior still requires a headed Windows release pass.
browsers.procedure: Run the release package in current stable Edge and exercise the seven required surfaces using docs/BROWSER_QA_MATRIX.md.

browsers.label: Mozilla Firefox
browsers.exception: The dependency-free browser smoke harness is Chrome DevTools Protocol based and cannot drive Firefox without adding a separate automation dependency; headed Firefox remains a release QA pass.
browsers.procedure: Run the release package in current stable Firefox and exercise the seven required surfaces using docs/BROWSER_QA_MATRIX.md.

browsers.label: Safari
browsers.exception: Safari is not available on the authoritative Ubuntu CI runner; WebKit-specific fullscreen, audio-unlock, storage, DPI, and performance behavior requires a headed macOS release pass.
browsers.procedure: Run the release package in current stable Safari on macOS and exercise the seven required surfaces using docs/BROWSER_QA_MATRIX.md.
